Assumptions & methodology

Formula

Σ(tokens ÷ 1,000,000 × price per 1M)

Input, output, and cached tokens are priced separately for every model row. Simple mode uses a user-defined percentage split.

Pricing provenance

Nous Portal catalog: GPT-5.6 Sol (batch) $2 input / $12 output; GPT-5.5 $4 input / $24 output per 1M. Checked Aug 9, 2026.

Assumption: cache-read defaults are 10% of input ($0.20 and $0.40 per 1M). They are not represented as published Nous Portal rates.

Estimate caveat

This client-side estimate is not an invoice or guaranteed Portal charge. “Cached/other” is the residual between Hermes total tokens and uncached input plus output, treated here as cache reads for estimation.

Currency conversions are illustrative fixed display rates; USD remains authoritative.
